Why Platio

Lunch, done right.

01
Fresh

Cooked today, just for you.

Your lunch is cooked fresh on the day it's delivered and arrives ready to enjoy. It's made for your day, with your name on it.

02
Premium Nutrition

Quality ingredients. Balanced nutrition.

Every meal is designed around the right mix of protein, carbs and healthy fats, using quality ingredients. Calories and macros are shown on every meal, and full ingredient details are listed on the menu, so you always know what's on your plate.

Protein
Carbs
Fat
Shown on every meal
03
Reliable · Control & flexibility

Lunch you can count on. A plan you control.

Lunch arrives Sunday to Thursday, before 1 PM. Plans change, so yours can too. Skip a day or pause for longer, any time up to 6 PM the day before. Skipped meals move to the end of your plan, so you never lose a meal you've paid for.

EXAMPLE · WEEK PLAN
SunLunch
MonLunch
TueSkipped
WedLunch
ThuLunch
SunTue's lunch
Skipped Tuesday? Your meal is added to the end of your plan. Nothing lost.

Taste

Healthy, without giving up flavour.
